statement: TSMC says advanced-packaging (CoWoS) capacity is so tight it is limiting customer growth, with the AI demand-supply gap 'very big' through 2029-2030.
why: Packaging is the primary bottleneck limiting AI accelerator output even as demand runs far ahead of supply.

impact.mechanism: Tight CoWoS capacity constrains GPU supply while very strong demand persists, keeping the market supply-limited.

evidence.source: The Motley Fool (TSMC Q2 2026 earnings call transcript)
evidence.excerpt: Our packaging capacity is so tight that it's limiting my customers' growth.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript of the earnings call; no primary filing fetched.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: The Motley Fool (TSMC Q2 2026 earnings call transcript)
